\]
If \(L\) is odd and \(a\) is even, parity stays odd; otherwise parity is \(L+a\pmod 2\). Hence \(S_k\equiv T_k\pmod 2\).

If step \(j\) is “special’’ (\(S_{j-1}\) odd, \(a_j\) even), then \(S_j=S_{j-1}-a_j\) instead of \(+a_j\), so the total is reduced by \(2a_j\). Thus
\[
S_k = T_k-2R_k,
